_meta.title: OOUX alignment — decision register
_meta.intro: Every terminology collision between the wiki and the canonical OOUX system map, with measured per-page blast radius and an expert recommendation. DECISION is your call per row; until you set it the row is “pending”. Source edits are applied as a batch once the register is settled. The prose 4-agent analysis is kept below as supporting detail.

decision_legend.adopt: Adopt the OOUX word as canonical
decision_legend.keep: Keep the wiki word (OOUX should adopt it)
decision_legend.alias: Wiki word stays canonical; OOUX word = registered product alias
decision_legend.split: Define the distinct constructs separately (no single winner)
decision_legend.product: Open product decision — needs a call, not just a word
decision_legend.fix-map: Correct the OOUX map to match the engine (don’t propagate)

collisions.title: The person object
collisions.meaning: Who the system is about. Wiki uses ‘Patient’ (clinical) and ‘User’ (product); OOUX makes ‘Member’ the single canonical actor.
collisions.recommended_note: Member as the product-surface alias keeps clinical/engine prose precise; ‘patient-reported outcomes’ and ‘patient safety’ are fixed terms and must NOT be renamed.
collisions.decision_note: DECIDED: adopt Member everywhere incl. demo data. Preserve fixed clinical terms (patient-reported outcomes/PRO, patient safety). Canon set in glossary ruling #10; prose/display propagation pending (code identifiers PatientState/keys preserved).

collisions.title: The headline band
collisions.meaning: The banded headline number. OOUX calls it ‘Confidence’; the wiki calls that same number ‘Accuracy’ and reserves ‘Confidence’ for a narrower trustworthiness sub-component. Same number, two names = highest-confusion collision.
collisions.recommended_note: Headline band = ‘Accuracy’ (wiki); Confidence + Sufficiency = its named sub-components; OOUX adopts ‘Accuracy’. NOT a blind replace — most ‘Confidence’ hits are the statistical sense.

collisions.title: The clinical signal
collisions.meaning: OOUX makes ‘Biomarker’ canonical; glossary ruling #9 makes ‘Marker’ canonical (it correctly spans lab + wearable + PRO, which ‘biomarker’ mis-scopes).
collisions.recommended_note: Keep Marker canonical in engine/clinical prose; Biomarker = My-Health product alias. Adopt OOUX object split MarkerDef / MeasuredValue / ReferenceRange (wiki already mirrors it).

collisions.title: Pillars
collisions.meaning: OOUX ‘PureScore Pillar’ = 4 off-UI backend themes (Risk/Reserve/Lifestyle/Vitality); the wiki’s 12 weighted clinical pillars are engine-load-bearing (calc-graph + _engine_guard enforces weights=1).
collisions.recommended_note: The 12 keep the word ‘Pillar’. OOUX’s 4 → rename ‘score facets / dimensions’, modelled as an optional roll-up ABOVE the 12, never a replacement.

collisions.title: Plan objects
collisions.meaning: OOUX adds a prescriber axis and a ‘Protocol’ object (member-authored) that collides with ruling #5’s prose calling the clinical template a ‘protocol’.
collisions.recommended_note: Three sharply-named constructs: Care pathway = clinical template (backend) · Care plan = clinician-prescribed instance · Protocol = member-authored lifestyle plan-per-goal. Reword ruling #5 to stop calling the template a ‘protocol’.

collisions.title: Action pipeline objects
collisions.ooux: Action Funnel · Insight · EnhancementAction · Value of Information
collisions.meaning: The wiki has anonymous selection stages; OOUX names them. Pure relabel, no math change.
collisions.recommended_note: §3 selection → Action Funnel · nudge-card payload → Insight · MEASURE/CLINICAL nudges → EnhancementAction · ΔAccuracy-per-effort ranking → Value of Information.

collisions.title: Daily contract: 1 hero vs top-5
collisions.meaning: OOUX surfaces ONE Daily Action/day (rest = NBAs); the wiki surfaces a top-5 card. Genuine product decision, not just a word.
collisions.recommended_note: Distinguish Daily Action (the one hero) from NBAs (the rest of the ranked set) in Doc 11 §3.3/§4.

collisions.title: Reward / acknowledgement surface
collisions.meaning: The wiki argues PureScore is the slow outcome, not the immediate reward, but never models the immediate-feedback surface. OOUX makes Daily Summary that surface.
collisions.recommended_note: Either adopt Daily Summary as the acknowledgement surface, or explicitly scope it out of the scoring spec.

collisions.title: Whole-app positioning
collisions.ooux: My Health owns the Biomarker Engine; PureScore = 1 of 10 features
collisions.meaning: OOUX: My Health owns the centralised Biomarker Engine + Timeline + KnowledgeLevel that every feature reads; PureScore is the embedded ‘present read’.
collisions.recommended_note: Invert biomarker ownership to My Health in Ch.2 + Doc 06; position PureScore as one of 10 features; add a ‘Where PureScore sits’ orientation.

collisions.title: Trust / data-sufficiency term
collisions.meaning: OOUX ‘KnowledgeLevel’ ↔ the wiki’s ‘Sufficiency’ + cohort-fallback. Same trust concept, different word.
collisions.recommended_note: Keep Sufficiency canonical in the engine; KnowledgeLevel = OOUX product-surface alias. Reconcile with the Confidence/Accuracy decision (#band).

collisions.title: Biological-age outcome
collisions.recommended_note: Keep BioAge canonical; HealthAge = product-surface alias (or adopt HealthAge if the app already ships it).

collisions.title: Goal vs Target setpoint
collisions.meaning: Ruling #6: keep capital Target for engine setpoints; lowercase ‘target value’ on a goal is fine. Already confirmed-aligned.
collisions.recommended_note: Confirmed aligned — keep both; PersonalGoal is just OOUX’s object name for the wiki’s Goal.

collisions.title: Stale numbers IN the OOUX map
collisions.meaning: The OOUX map is a snapshot of the older 9-reservoir sim. Aligning literally would REGRESS the engine — so this flows the other way: fix the map.
collisions.recommended_note: Re-sync the OOUX map text to JSON canon: reservoirs 9→15, knobs 16→19, horizons, and 13/66 → 12/26 (trace or correct).
collisions.decision_note: Applied: map '13 systems / 66 diseases' → '12 systems / 26 diseases' (verified vs conditions.json). Reservoir/knob counts not present in the map's visible text; outcome horizons left as-is (canon unsettled — whats-new uses 90/180/365).
